name: Bloodmage Thalnos
summary: Bloodmage Thalnos is a skeletal spellcaster who haunts the Graveyard wing of the Scarlet Monastery. Who he was in life is not recorded, but the plague of undeath claimed him, and he now lingers deep within the Crusade's holy grounds, hungering for vengeance.

sections.title: A Mage Risen in Death
sections.body: No record tells who Thalnos was in life. Whatever his past, the plague of undeath claimed him. Rather than being cleansed or permanently destroyed, he rose as a withered skeleton, still clinging to his fiery magic and arcane mastery, and crying out for vengeance and for more souls.

sections.title: Master of the Graveyard
sections.body: Confined to the deepest corner of the monastery's courtyard tombs, Thalnos commands apparitions and shambling undead minions against anyone who disturbs his domain. His continued presence poses a bitter contradiction for the Crusade: an undead monstrosity lingering right beneath their sacred halls, embodying the very horror they swore an eternity to eradicate.

faq.answer: Thalnos is a skeletal spellcaster haunting the Monastery's graveyard. Who he was in life is not recorded; the plague of undeath claimed him, and he rose as an undead mage who still hungers for vengeance.

faq.q: Why is an undead skeleton allowed in the Scarlet Monastery?
aliases: why does scarlet crusade keep thalnos
faq.answer: The Crusade fanatically executes all undead on sight, making Thalnos's survival anomalous. Stowed away at the far end of the Graveyard amidst risen crypts and spirits, he prowls his own blighted domain rather than walking freely among the living crusaders.

Despite retaining the title of Bloodmage and rising as a skeleton, Thalnos commands fiery spells, shadow magic, and summons vengeful spirits and walking dead to overwhelm trespassers in the graveyard.
His original mortal lineage is uncertain. The title Bloodmage alone does not establish that he was a blood elf.

aliases: the dark side of the light thalnos
faq.answer: Thalnos is hostile to intruders in the monastery's graveyard. No specific commission to kill him is established here for this era.

angles.text: Thalnos shows how the plague can twist a gifted spellcaster into a vengeful thing that still wields fire and shadow.
The Forsaken see in Thalnos what they escaped: an undead mage with no will left but vengeance, lurking at the heart of the Scarlet Crusade's own monastery.
Standing amidst the tombs, Thalnos is an unsettling sign that all the Crusade's zeal has not kept darkness from its own holy ground.
